purpose: Directly test whether changing the identity of the rewarded wrong result changes where one-step cross-task transfer appears, while holding the number of rewarded candidates and all non-identity treatment components fixed.

provenance_and_outcome_awareness.relationship_to_r11: NEW DRAFT ONLY. This file does not amend, supersede, authorize, or modify the frozen R11 package.
provenance_and_outcome_awareness.outcome_awareness: R12 was designed after R10 development outcomes and after an identification audit of R11. It can never be relabelled confirmatory.
provenance_and_outcome_awareness.design_freeze_rule: Any change to the arms, derangement, selected stacks, estimands, gates, or evidence boundary requires a new schema version and a new independent review before authorization.

why_r11_is_not_shared_identity_causal_pr: R11 intervenes on BUG versus GOLD_ONLY, so it identifies the effect of adding a frozen false-positive reward relative to clean gold-only learning under the fixed one-step setup.
R11 does not intervene on whether the rewarded wrong identity is aligned or misaligned with the target identity.

R11 structural excess D is a contrast across target columns of the same observed effect matrix; it is treatment-effect heterogeneity within the fixed codebook, not a randomized identity-alignment intervention.
R11's enumeration of 120 identity bijections re-labels the same observed matrix and is a deterministic sensitivity diagnostic, not a randomization test or an inferential p-value.
Therefore an R11 pass may support a reward-specification-specific bridge, but it cannot by itself establish that shared result identity is the causal channel.

derangement_properties: one-to-one and onto over the five frozen identities
every wrong identity is used exactly once across the five source identities
chosen by a canonical cyclic rule rather than by observed outcomes

canonical_pilot_stacks.selection_rule: Take the first M0/A_TO_B stack in the pre-existing frozen order for each task pair. The choice is canonical and not based on stack outcomes.
canonical_pilot_stacks.statistical_boundary: The two task pairs are a development pilot only. Mapping stacks, identities, target cells, OS processes, and technical replicates are not independent task-pair samples.

GOLD_ONLY.reward_mask_rule: reward gold candidate with 1 and all six non-gold candidates with 0

BUG_ALIGNED.reward_mask_rule: reward gold candidate with 1 and the frozen wrong candidate for source identity r with 1; all other candidates receive 0

BUG_PERMUTED.reward_mask_rule: reward gold candidate with 1 and the frozen wrong candidate for identity pi(r) under CYCLIC_PLUS_ONE_R1 with 1; all other candidates receive 0

identity_switch_contrast.only_permitted_difference: which frozen wrong identity receives the second positive reward: r versus pi(r)

contrast_control.gold_contrast_boundary: GOLD_ONLY has one rewarded candidate whereas both BUG arms have two. A therefore estimates the effect of adding the aligned false-positive reward relative to clean learning; it does not separately identify reward-count or gradient-dose mediation. The primary shared-identity test is C, whose two arms have matched reward count and mass.

MINIMAL_6_PROCESS.process_formula: 2 stacks x 3 arms x 1 technical replicate
MINIMAL_6_PROCESS.interpretation: lowest-cost single-execution development pilot; provides no independent technical reproducibility evidence

REPRODUCIBILITY_12_PROCESS.process_formula: 2 stacks x 3 arms x 2 technical replicates
REPRODUCIBILITY_12_PROCESS.interpretation: same scientific design with an exact substantive reproducibility gate; A and B remain technical repeats, not independent scientific samples

execution_variants.preauthorization_choice_rule: Exactly one execution variant must be selected and frozen before any model authorization. It is forbidden to run replicate A under the 6-process variant, inspect outcomes, and then add replicate B conditionally.

potential_outcomes_and_estimands.outcome: Y(k,s,r,q,arm) is the frozen post-update target metric for replicate k, stack s, source identity r, target identity q, and arm; all arms must have byte- and trace-identical pre measurements.
potential_outcomes_and_estimands.C_interpretation: C>0 means that switching the rewarded wrong identity from r to pi(r) shifts relative transfer away from q=r and toward q=pi(r), within the fixed affine codebook.
aggregation_order: compute A and C within technical replicate k and exact cell (s,r)
for the 12-process variant, require the frozen replicate-consistency gate before averaging A and B equally
equal-average the five source identities within each selected stack/task pair
equal-average the two task-pair means only for a descriptive overall summary
report all identity-level and task-pair-level values without treating nested cells as independent samples
potential_outcomes_and_estimands.inference_boundary: No standard error, confidence interval, p-value, permutation p-value, or population-level task claim is permitted from two task-pair clusters.

technical_pass_requires_all: complete selected 6-process or 12-process design with no missing, duplicate, swapped, or extra cell
exact canonical reward mask for every row, source identity, arm, and derangement binding
BUG_ALIGNED and BUG_PERMUTED differ only in r versus pi(r) for the second rewarded candidate
all cross-arm source, target, candidate, model, checkpoint, initial-state, update-recipe, evaluator, and environment bindings match
fresh checkpoint reset before every source identity
all outcomes and diagnostics are finite
for the 12-process variant, A/B substantive matrices satisfy a pre-frozen reproducibility tolerance

failure_labels.A_GATE_FAILURE: The aligned false-positive reward does not consistently improve the matched target relative to GOLD_ONLY; stop the proposed bridge mechanism.
failure_labels.C_GATE_FAILURE_WITH_A_POSITIVE: A false-positive reward effect may exist, but rewarded wrong identity has not been shown to causally determine where transfer appears; do not use a shared-identity mechanism claim.
failure_labels.TECHNICAL_GATE_FAILURE: No scientific interpretation; repair and create a new frozen version before any rerun. Outcome-dependent retry is forbidden.

development_decision_rule.identity_heterogeneity_policy: Report all 5 identity-level A and C values and their signs. They are fixed codebook levels and are not independent samples. Identity-level unanimity is not a minimum-pilot pass gate, but any negative identities must be carried forward as an explicit limitation and boundary condition.
development_decision_rule.stop_after_result: Any gate failure ends this frozen pilot version. No adaptive arm, stack, identity, threshold, permutation, or hyperparameter change is permitted within the same version.

result_validator_minimum_requirements: recompute canonical reward-mask hashes from bound rows, ordered candidates, arm, r, and pi(r); a non-empty string is insufficient
bind each result to its exact arm contract, execution manifest, external authorization receipt, and invocation receipt
reject arm swaps, derangement drift, reward-mask tampering, cross-arm data drift, cross-replicate binding drift, clipping, and missing cells
recompute A, DeltaSwitch, and C from raw target metrics
record raw gradient norm and realized update norm as diagnostics without outcome-dependent norm matching
label all summaries development-only and non-inferential

claim_boundary.can_support_if_passed: Development-only evidence, in two selected task pairs and one frozen affine codebook, that causally switching which wrong identity is rewarded changes the relative target identity receiving one-step transfer.
cannot_support: a claim that OS processes, technical replicates, source identities, or target cells are independent scientific samples
claim_boundary.next_stage_if_passed: Freeze a separate design with at least six new, outcome-independent task-pair clusters and an externally justified practical margin before attempting task-pair-level inference.
